description: A low, wide room glazed on the mews side and open to the stair on the other. A chrome board names the four terrace levels. A bootscraper is set into the floor, unused. It smells faintly of wet soil from the planting upstairs.

window.description: Floor to ceiling along the mews, so the hall is bright and entirely visible from outside. The view is Vetch Mews, which is a made road with nothing on the far side of it yet.
window.name: the mews glazing

name: Terms Agreed — The Entrance Hall
